gui.djbooth.guide1: Type a song or paste a link, press Enter
gui.djbooth.guide2: Play · Cue (right=set) · Tempo · Jog=scrub/pitch · click screen=seek
gui.djbooth.hotcue: Hot cue %s: click sets or jumps
gui.djbooth.eq_hi: HIGH sweep: turn down to close a low-pass (20 kHz → 25 Hz). Double-click = open
gui.djbooth.eq_mid: MID sweep: bell centre 20 kHz → 100 Hz. Double-click = open
gui.djbooth.eq_low: LOW sweep: low-pass 100 Hz → 20 Hz. Double-click = open
gui.djbooth.filter: Colour filter (left = low-pass, right = high-pass, double-click = off)
gui.djbooth.echo: Echo FX (drag up for more; double-click = off)
gui.djbooth.eq_curve: Sweep resonance: ISO = sharp, EQ = gentle
gui.djbooth.fader_curve: Channel fader: SHARP = steep, LIN = linear
gui.djbooth.tap: Tap on the beat to measure BPM
